about_the_game:
You are the cashier at a gas-station convenience store, working the night shift. It seems simple: restock shelves, clean up the floor, and serve the occasional customer. But with each shift, something feels off.

The lights flicker for no reason. Regulars start acting strange. And one night you realize—someone who walks through that door is no longer human.

Night Shift Customer is an atmospheric horror sim about manning the register, talking to customers, and catching the smallest signs that something’s wrong. With AI-driven dialogue, every customer behaves unpredictably: they might make small talk, complain about life, or ask unsettling questions. Stay alert—sooner or later their speech, movements, and mannerisms begin to change…

Features

  • A haunting vibe of a night gas station, dim aisles, and an empty road.

  • Live conversations with AI-driven NPCs—every shift and every talk is unique.

  • Everyday routines: cleaning, restocking, and serving customers.

  • Slow-burn tension that escalates from subtle oddities to an encounter with what hides behind a human face.

  • Your goal: survive and identify which customer has become the monster—before it’s too late.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or new-gen i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700xt or greater

short_description: A night shift at a minimarket turns into a nightmare. Serve customers, tidy the store, and watch for oddities - one of them isn’t human anymore.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Simplified Chinese*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support
